title: Learning to Reason About Implicit Multimodal Harm: From Diagnosis to Generalization
abstract: arXiv:2605.29951v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A benign image paired with a benign caption can become harmful only in combination, making detection fundamentally a cross-modal reasoning problem. Existing multimodal harm benchmarks evaluate only classification accuracy, leaving unclear whether models identify the cross-modal mechanism that produces harm. We introduce MuPHI (Multimodal Pragmatic Harm Interpretation), a controlled diagnostic benchmark in which harm arises purely from image-text composition, with benign counterfactuals and annotated harm rationales. Using MuPHI, we systematically evaluate where compositional harm reasoning breaks in vision-language models (VLMs). MuPHI reveals that VLMs reliably ground each modality yet fail to bind the evidence into the harm mechanism and their predictions respond weakly to label-determining counterfactual interventions. translated_title: 学习对隐式多模态危害进行推理：从诊断到泛化
translated_abstract: 一张无害的图片配上无害的文字说明，只有在组合在一起时才可能变得有害，这使得此类检测在本质上是一个跨模态推理问题。现有的多模态危害基准仅评估分类准确率，尚不清楚模型是否真正识别了产生危害的跨模态机制。我们提出了MuPHI（多模态语用危害解释），这是一个受控诊断基准，其中危害纯粹源于图像与文本的组合，并配有良性反事实样本和经过标注的危害成因解释。借助MuPHI，我们系统地评估了视觉-语言模型（VLMs）中组合式危害推理的失效环节。MuPHI揭示：VLMs能够可靠地理解单一模态的信息，却无法将证据关联到危害机制之中，且其预测对决定标签的反事实干预响应微弱。此外，现有基于标签训练的危害检测方法虽能显著提升域内（ID）检测性能，但……
tldr: 提出MuPHI诊断基准，揭示视觉-语言模型虽能理解单一模态信息，却无法将图像-文本组合推理为危害机制，为隐式多模态危害检测从诊断走向泛化提供了方向。
en_tdlr: We introduce MuPHI, a controlled diagnostic benchmark revealing that VLMs can ground each modality but fail to bind cross-modal evidence into the harm mechanism, advancing implicit multimodal harm detection from diagnosis to generalization.
